texts.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。
“我亲眼可见他们的政府在倾听人民的呼声，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近有说道。“事实上，我自己很难想象出一个更好的体制了。”

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

# 入乡随俗 / Gone Native

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:2558-2962`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：特使驻在某国，无 recent_envoy_event；权重20/180。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: An envoy posted to a country, no recent_envoy_event; weight 20 of 180.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

特使“入乡随俗”。选项：保留职位，或召回重训（特使进入惩罚冷却）。

The envoy "goes native". Options: keep the post or recall for retraining (the envoy enters a punishment cooldown).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一。

One of two.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
